decoder.buildStatus: inferred schema version; not independently verified game client build

policy.flag: Raw decoded opcode0x10 members=true; absence defaults false. This is an audit of every decoded ID, without name matching or Wiki identity resolution.
policy.exclusions: Unnamed IDs and all note/loan/bind/combine template fields stay in this table even though the ordinary-name resolver excludes them.
policy.inheritance: Template records carry their own raw opcode bits. No template inheritance is evaluated here. A false bit on an unnamed note/loan/bind/combine definition does not certify its linked ordinary item as free. Ordinary item names use the independently reviewed name/ID resolver.
